note: Use affine coordinates A=(0,0), B=(1,0), C=(0,1). With x=BD/DC, y=CE/EA, z=AF/FB, obtain D=(1/(1+x),x/(1+x)), E=(0,1/(1+y)), F=(z/(1+z),0). Lines are AD: Y=xX; BE: X+(1+y)Y=1; CF: (1+z)X+zY=z. Intersection AD cap BE is P=(1/Delta,x/Delta), Delta=1+x(1+y). Membership P in CF is equivalent to 1+z+zx=z(1+x+xy), hence xyz=1.
